about_page_title: Hi, I'm Thales do Prado Menendez!
about_paragraph_1: I am a beginner technology enthusiast in front-end development and user interface creation. My goal is to develop my skills in creating intuitive and user-friendly interfaces. I am very excited about the internship opportunity at BlueRise, as I believe it is the ideal environment to apply and expand my knowledge in technologies like React and TypeScript, and for personal development in general.
about_paragraph_2: My goal is to grow as a developer, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to challenging projects. This technical test was an excellent opportunity to demonstrate my dedication and willingness to learn, and I hope to learn much more during the process.
